title: Authoritative exploded RFC-SOL-0001 representation profile

base_spec.normativity: non-normative debug/corpus representation; the physical .solnb container (section 14.6) is the normative interchange form

notes: Object payloads are stored flat under objects/sha256/ named by the full 64-hex sha256 digest (no sharding).
Each object payload has a companion record at objects/records/<sha256-hex>.json (the object-record schema class).
diagnostics.json holds committed Level-2 diagnostics. expected_diagnostics.json is corpus-only (the expected diagnostic set) and is not part of the artifact.
The machine summary is a pseudo-render at renders/machine_summary.json; committed renders are renders/<render_id>.json.

instances.description: Original 31-case prototype corpus (GOLD-01..06, PATH-001..025); the OpenAI-sandbox 31/31 lineage.
Current 37-case corpus (adds PATH-026..031 for V0-07..V0-13); GOLD-01 reassembled from the spec examples with real digests.

purpose: Designates the authoritative exploded RFC-SOL-0001 representation that SOL-QRY v0.3 freeze-gate condition 8 (exact evaluator runs over the authoritative exploded RFC-SOL-0001 representation) evaluates against. This is the publication + designation step that clears the condition 8 blocker.
